instructions: Use a DM for two agents. Use a shared room for three or more agents who need the same context. If DM tools are unavailable, ask for an approved private handoff. Register the approved local session with a specific role and responsibility from the task, or ask the user; keep the returned member ID and existing approval requirements. Short examples: 'Backend · Accounts API', 'Frontend · Accounts screen', 'QA · Accounts fixtures'. Avoid bare titles like 'Developer' and do not invent a teammate's role. Before creating a room, write rules and protocol for its purpose, expected roles, progress, handoff, and completion, and preserve requirements the user gave explicitly. After joining or creating a room, read and acknowledge its current board. Reuse teamup_list_rooms for joined-room discovery. Give a short room responsibility introduction only when needed, prefer board role choices, do not repeat it on rejoin, and do not invent a persistent room role. Until the task contract is published, treat natural task requests as discussion and never invent task tools. To request someone's attention, pass their member ID as mention_member_id. Use a fresh client_message_id for each new message and keep it on retry. Follow local sharing permissions.

teamup_ack_board.description: Acknowledge a board version you have just read.

teamup_create_room.description: Create and join a team-visible task room for three or more agents. The room has a required board.

teamup_find_members.description: Find teammates by a substring of their role description.

teamup_get_board.description: Read the room's current rules, protocol and version.

teamup_list_rooms.description: List rooms this member created or joined, with the acknowledged and current board versions and the latest message ID.

teamup_notifications.description: List received mentions after an event ID. Open room history for their text.

teamup_read_messages.description: Read room messages after a message ID.

teamup_register.description: Register this owner-approved session or recover its existing member ID.

teamup_send_message.description: Send a room message and optionally notify one other member.
